criteria.title: Implement a four-entry clean page cache whose tags identify exact physical pages; keep transaction-owned dirty nodes outside the cache.
criteria.task: Trace physical pages colliding in the four-entry clean cache while dirty transaction nodes remain in separate typed scratch. Verify exact tags on hit and derive fixed cache plus scratch memory costs.
criteria.purpose: A cache slot index identifies the requested page or dirty scratch may be written through.
